verified: 2026-11-18, two layouts checked on the live site. Full loop from the side panel in Chrome (signed in, real bridge): READY, then fs.readFile, fs.createFile, fs.writeFile each ran once and the file was written byte-identical, final answer delivered. Signed in: ProseMirror composer ([data-composer-markdown]) filled through insertText, Enter-to-send, reply in [data-markdown-text-style=assistant-message], [data-talvt-turn-state=in_progress] while streaming, plus the composer's send/stop button (every size-token composer button but the voice one) which covers the ~2-5 s before the turn starts: without it a virtualized list (older turns leave the DOM, so the message count changes) could re-offer the previous reply as new, code blocks ([data-code-block], drawn by CodeMirror that renders only on-screen lines: a 200-line block had no .cm-line in the DOM, the full code came from React props via the page-source helper) and the code header ([data-markdown-copy=exclude]). Logged out (StyleX redesign): textarea[name=prompt] filled through the value setter, li[data-message-role] turns with [data-assistant-markdown-root], data-message-streaming, code header next to [data-message-content-controls]. Selectors avoid aria-labels, which follow the UI language. The #prompt-textarea / data-message-author-role / stop-button entries cover the older layout and are not re-verified
